app_info.subtitle: Your context across agents
app_info.description: Context helps you carry goals and work across AI agents. Sign in with Google to create plans, track Issues, attach documents and request human reviews in your Shared workspace, also available on the web. Nomi guides setup and the first useful workflow. Optionally pair the Context iPhone app and reconnect to access authorized private memories, people, logs, health, calendar and stored playbooks. Access is permissioned; agents cannot approve human review gates.

test_cases.description: Start a Google-only Shared workspace session.
test_cases.expected_output: Introduces Nomi, reports available Shared access and offers to turn one goal into a plan; bundled onboarding must not require a phone or manual skill upload for the web workflow.

test_cases.description: Create a small plan and verify persistence.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a Shared plan called Weekend reading, with two Issues: choose a book and schedule one reading session.
test_cases.tools_triggered: setup, list_spaces, create_epic, create_issues, get_epic, list_issues
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the requested Epic and two child Issues in Shared, then reads them back and reports saved records without claiming unconfirmed delivery.

test_cases.description: Find existing work without changing it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find my Weekend reading plan in Context and show its unfinished Issues.
test_cases.expected_output: Finds the reviewer-created plan and summarizes only the saved unfinished Issues; reports an empty result if the fixture is absent.

test_cases.description: Attach a document and preserve its revision history.
test_cases.user_prompt: Attach a short reading checklist to the choose-a-book Issue, then revise the checklist to include a Sunday session.
test_cases.tools_triggered: setup, search_context, get_issue, attach_artifact, get_artifact, revise_artifact
test_cases.expected_output: Attaches a checklist, reads its current revision, appends the requested revision using that version, and reads back the new head while retaining prior content.

test_cases.description: Request a human decision without approving it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Ask me to review the reading checklist and wait for my decision.
test_cases.expected_output: Opens a review request on the relevant Issue and reports its pending state; does not approve the request or close a human gate.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for live weather.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What will the weather be in Singapore tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Context should not be invoked because it does not provide live weather forecasts.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for sending external email.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send an email to my accountant asking for the latest invoice.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Context should not be invoked because it cannot send email or external messages.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for live market quotes.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is Apple’s current share price?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Context should not be invoked because it is not a live financial-market data source.
